what: p_a2 --save-gradients -> p_a4 --gfile, i.e. the closed-form experiment run from a blob produced by the live chain
why: the audit found that p_a4 read p_a2_v2.pt while no current script wrote it: gfile_sha256 verified the identity of an input nobody could rebuild. p_a2 now writes the blob with its own manifest.

p_a2_side_check.note: the blob was written by this same run, so |pw| 134.1488 is the input p_a4 saw

determinism_check.what: the same blob was fed to p_a4 twice
determinism_check.result: identical (1.307 / 1.151 both times) -> p_a4 is a deterministic function of its blob

run_to_run_band.cause: a DIFFERENT pathwise run: |pw| moved only 2e-4 relative (134.1488 vs 134.1485) yet dJ2 moved 0.45%, because dJ2 is a nonlinear readout of the gradient direction. So p_a4 numbers carry a ~0.5% run-to-run band and must be quoted with it rather than to four decimals
run_to_run_band.not_claimed: this is measured, not explained: the mechanism (pathwise reduction order) is plausible and unproven
